message: Morning Christian. The plan's been rinsed. Two things a day now: **one video** and **one Czech lesson**. That's it — the whole calendar fits in one line.

The old version asked for two reels a day, a weekly long form, two shoot days and five pillars. That was a production company's schedule handed to one person who also runs markets on weekends. You didn't fall behind because you're lazy; you fell behind because it was unbuildable. One shoot day on Monday banks the week's seven videos, and the other six days you post one and do your lesson. If the bank runs low, Monday gets longer — the other days don't.

Czech starts today. Tap **Czech** under the greeting and Day 1 is sitting there: five words, one rule, three things to say out loud. Fifteen minutes. The course is frequency-first — you'll learn 'beer' long before 'library' — and it deliberately skips the case tables that make people quit Czech in month two. Two cases and one tense in thirty days, and you'll be able to hold a real exchange.

The first three days are pure sound system. Czech spelling is genuinely one-to-one with pronunciation, so a few days upfront means you can say any word you ever see, forever. Highest-return thing in the course, which is why it's front-loaded.

Still unfilmed: the baseline. It's Day 4 of the build. I've led with it every morning and I'm not going to keep doing that — but one video a day only starts properly once there's a Day 1 in the can, and today is a market day, which is the easiest filming you'll ever do.

radar: One video a day is slower to monetisation than the old plan — dropping the weekly long form costs you the watch-hours route to YouTube partner. That's a real trade and the right one for now; add long form back only when a single video obviously deserves it

The Czech lesson is a fixture, not content. But if a day's lesson gives you something genuinely funny or hard, thirty seconds of it is a free second series — optional, and don't let it become a second job
TODOIST_TOKEN still isn't set in the repo secrets, so the morning job can only update the day counter, not your actual list
Nothing maximal until 1 Oct — the hamstring gate is the one thing that would end the whole arc
